sources.title: OCI Release Notes - All Services
sources.fallback_text: Object Storage Supports Amazon S3 Virtual-Hosted Style URLs. Services: Object Storage. Release Date: February 10, 2026. This release can affect architecture impact analysis for storage access patterns, application compatibility, and migration guidance. Improved flow for requesting limit increases. Services: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Release Date: March 11, 2026. This release can affect operational planning for service limits and capacity management. Secrets in Vault is now Secret Management Service. Services: Secret Management. Release Date: January 22, 2026. This release can affect security architecture, secrets handling, and naming assumptions. Monitoring alarm delivery adds enhanced troubleshooting fields. Services: Monitoring. Release Date: April 9, 2026. This release can affect observability architecture, runbooks, metrics, and operational diagnostics. Database backup replication improves cross-region recovery options. Services: Database Services. Release Date: April 18, 2026. This release can affect HA/DR architecture, RTO/RPO planning, backup recovery, and regression validation.
